name: How do you ensure the detached suite matches the architecture of the main home?
description: We match exterior architectural details such as roof pitch, window trim, paint colors, and wall textures like stucco to ensure a cohesive appearance.

mainEntity.name: How do you ensure the detached suite matches the architecture of the main home?

acceptedAnswer.text: Your home’s existing exterior design should directly influence the roof pitch, trim profiles, siding, and wall finishes selected for the detached unit. If your primary residence features a stucco finish, applying full-house stuccoing and matching paint tones to the detached suite creates visual harmony across the parcel. Matching window styles, overhang depths, and architectural details ensures the suite looks like an intentional, cohesive addition to the property rather than an afterthought, which also protects overall curb appeal and resale value.
